bind.description: IP address or hostname to bind the server to (e.g., '127.0.0.1' or '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces).

port.description: TCP port number for the web server to listen on.

upload_dir.description: Absolute path to the directory where uploaded files will be stored.

max_file_size.description: Maximum file size allowed for uploads, in bytes (e.g., 104857600 = 100 MiB).

auth_enabled.description: Enable HTTP Basic Authentication to restrict uploads to authorized users.

auth_file.description: Path to the htpasswd file containing user credentials (used only when auth is enabled).

auth_realm.description: Authentication realm string displayed in the login prompt.

allow_overwrite.description: Allow uploading files with names that already exist (overwriting them).

max_concurrent_uploads.description: Maximum number of simultaneous upload sessions allowed.

custom_message.description: Custom HTML snippet to display above the upload form on the main page (e.g., instructions or disclaimer).

ssl_enabled.description: Enable HTTPS using the provided SSL certificate and key.

ssl_cert.description: Path to the SSL certificate file (PEM format) — required when SSL is enabled.

ssl_key.description: Path to the SSL private key file (PEM format) — required when SSL is enabled.

allowed_mime_types.description: List of allowed MIME types for uploaded files (e.g., ['image/jpeg', 'application/pdf']). Empty = allow all.

allowed_extensions.description: List of allowed file extensions (e.g., ['.jpg', '.pdf']). Empty = allow all extensions.

items.description: A file extension string with dot (e.g., '.txt', '.docx').

log_file.description: Path to the log file (use '-' to log to standard output).
